description: What a host (a host process, a mesh member) is doing or why it can't be reached, as Baude's banners, its hosts list and the menu bar say it.

messages.stopping_left: .input {$total :number} .match $total one {{{$host} stopping — {$left :number} of {$total} process to stop}} * {{{$host} stopping — {$left :number} of {$total} processes to stop}}
messages.restarting_left: .input {$total :number} .match $total one {{{$host} restarting — {$left :number} of {$total} process to stop}} * {{{$host} restarting — {$left :number} of {$total} processes to stop}}
messages.no_id: it gave no id Baude can use
messages.connection_dropped: the connection to its host dropped
messages.none_started: no host process here, and none could be started (see {$log})
